decisions.statement: One post is in flight at a time.
An item outside the backpack is never posted.
The item is set pending before the post is issued.
The post is issued from the game's pending-item event.
A caller asking while a post is in flight is answered false.
A trading house error settles the post as failed.
Disposal unregisters the three events the flow registered.

definition: the handshake the game asks for before an item goes up for sale
